
  ✓ devbox-2 is set up                                                          in 4m48s

  Claude Code and Codex are installed and run as the agent, an account without sudo
  that can install Ubuntu packages (keelbox install). SSH from the internet is closed;
  the box is on your tailnet.

╭─ Start working ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ This computer   keelbox attach devbox-2                                              │
│                 opens the agent's terminal on the box. Close it and the work carries │
│                 on; run it again to come back.                                       │
│                                                                                      │
│ Claude app      Remote Control: the Code tab in the Claude app, or claude.ai/code.   │
│                 Sessions run on devbox-2.                                            │
│                                                                                      │
│ Phone over SSH  add your phone's key to the box first:                               │
│                 https://keelbox.dev/docs/guides/sessions                             │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Check the box   keelbox doctor devbox-2        all boxes: keelbox ls
  Admin shell     keelbox ssh devbox-2 --admin
                  for anything that needs root; the agent has no sudo
